 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0048
 Nathaniel Fleming, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
3-24-24
Counsel for defendant:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant, for its answer to Plaintiff's Original Petition, respectfully shows the Court as follows.
Pursuant to Rule 92 of the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure, Defendant generally denies each and every allegation
contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence.
For further answer, and without assuming any burden of proof that the law places on Plaintiff, Defendant asserts the
following affirmative defenses. First, the collision at the intersection was caused in whole or in part by Plaintiff's own
negligence, inclduing failure to yield the right-of-way, failure to keep a proper lookout, and entering the intersection
against a traffic control device. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must
be reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and bars recovery if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, Defendant invokes the proportionate responsibility provisions of Chapter 33 as to any other person whose
negligence contributed to the occurrence. Third, Plaintiff's claimed damages, including medical expenses, were not
reasonable or necessary, and Defendant reserves its right to contest them under Section 41.0105 of the Texas Civil
Practice and Remedies Code.
</page>

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
